items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Jenny came to New York with me and we worked at the Onyx Club in the beginning during intermission.

ctx.x: Well actually I had been encouraged by a lot of the musicians that would come to the Benjamin Harrison Literary Club because I would think that it was as much as seven or eight months since Gladys Mosier had been at the club. But I was at the Benjamin Literary Club for a year and I saved my money and I decided I was going to take an excursion and come to New York to see what would happen. And that was during the summer of 1937. So Jenny Dillard, the pianist at the club, and I took off this particular summer…
And you told us about your search for Mr. Pincus, and your auditioning all the way down.
